en: The Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Cultivation (Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka)
Dependent on a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state whose root is both not to be abandoned by cultivation and not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of cause-condition, there are nine; in object-condition, six; in predominance-condition, five …pe… in resultant-condition, one …pe… in non-disappearance-condition, nine.
